blocking_rule: For every previous complete model in the same sector, append one 360-literal clause that is false on exactly that primary selection vector; auxiliary variables are not part of the block.
candidate_acceptance: complete assignment assigns every declared variable exactly once
every clause of the cumulative CNF satisfied
selected primary mechanism has named fault weight <=10, empty detector syndrome, nonzero logical action, canonical and physical supports outside stabilizer span
complete translated selector orbit has size 72
translated schedules and mechanisms all replay
orbit has zero collision with installed registry and every earlier accepted batch orbit
collision_rule: An orbit collision does not count toward the target; its model remains retained and blocked before the next attempt.
frontier_rule: Atomically append only all complete accepted free 72-element orbits from both sectors, build/check an unstarted iteration-192 base and 71-root quotient, and do not solve iteration 192.
root_scope: This is a finite selector-batch continuation. It is not a root theorem and cannot change canonical Gross unless a separate complete branch proof appears.
stop_rule: For each sector stop immediately at four accepted collision-free parents including mandatory, or at 12 total attempts, or on proof-checked UNSAT/UNKNOWN. Never expand.
unknown_rule: UNKNOWN or timeout supplies no verdict and stops that sector without accepting the attempt.
unsat_rule: An additional cumulative formula returning UNSAT counts only after DRAT and LRAT acceptance plus corrupt/truncated rejection; then enumeration stops for that sector because the blocking sequence is exhausted.
